d3-selection v3.0.0 -- https://github.com/d3/d3-selection
Bundled here (publication/vendor/d3-selection-3.0.0.min.js) so that the
generated HTML figures render offline, with no call to any CDN, for as long as
a browser exists. It is the only third-party JavaScript used.

SHA-256 of the bundled file:
45daab9cf677901bcae102f3f23ca2930db3c0fb8ff9e3dbed087d9c4de921ca
